_note: OOE-APRIME-C-1028 (owner decision OD-1028(38), 2026-10-28: "a' + c"). The ONE source of truth for the layer-2 classifier categories: vera/scope_router.py derives LAYER2_CATEGORIES, REFUSE_CATEGORIES, the refusal precedence and scan spellings, the parser, the disposition logic and the classifier prompt's category list and meanings from this table. OWNER-CURATED and READ-ONLY at runtime: no code path adds or modifies rows (security: the model must never create a research route). Validated on load, at service start via main.py and on any later import (unique codes, known dispositions, a rank for each refusing row, aliases colliding with no code or other alias, mutually dissimilar descriptions); an invalid table stops the service from starting (fail closed). Dispositions: in_scope = answered; off_topic = well-formed out-of-scope verdict (reading list / coverage path); refuse = fixed refusal, never answered, listed or acquired; unsupported_use = fixed unsupported-use sentence plus reading list (also a refusal category: never answered or acquired). refusal_rank = precedence when a reply names several refusal categories (1 = strongest).
aliases_note: OD-1028(38): aliases map a classifier OUTPUT label to a code, never user text. Empty until label logs (scope classifier out-of-enum category: label=...) justify one; each alias is an owner decision.
description_similarity_note: Owner rule 2026-10-28: 'a new C entry must have a significantly dissimlar description from all other descriptions'. Load check (vera/scope_router.py description_similarity, DESCRIPTION_SIMILARITY_MAX; review D1 2026-10-28): max of (a) Jaccard of suffix-stemmed content tokens and (b) character-trigram Jaccard over the sorted content tokens; lowercased, stopwords (incl. 'defined', 'below') removed. Plain token Jaccard was evaded by plural/word-form paraphrases. Calibration on these six descriptions (2026-10-28): pairwise max 0.203 (harmful vs rule_change), next 0.172 (advice vs harmful), 0.148 (advice vs programming_task). Threshold 0.50 = max + 0.297 margin. Reviewer paraphrase probes: four of five score 0.60-0.67 and are rejected; a synonym paraphrase of harmful ('requesting operational assistance in causing harms') scores 0.429 and still passes (known limit: no synonym knowledge; owner curation remains the control). Planner prior, not measured on rejected candidates; re-calibrate when a row is added.
attestation_note: SEMSIM-RELEASE-1028: default off. When true, config/category_attestation.json (written at release time by scripts/attest_category_descriptions.py, which needs the local embedding model) must hold the sha256 of the current descriptions; a mismatch is a ScopeConfigError at import. The flag must be a literal true or false (anything else is a ScopeConfigError). The attestation is a process control, not authentication: the owner commits the attestation file as part of the release, its model_manifest_sha256 and threshold_category must equal config/semantic_similarity.json (threshold non-null), and the hash alone is not proof the model ran. To re-attest after editing descriptions just run the tool; it parses the table without the attestation check, so the flag need not be toggled. The runtime never loads the embedding model (512 MB limit).
